summary: LQR House Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Note Purchase Agreement with non-U.S. purchasers, issuing up to $60 million in unsecured promissory notes due May 20, 2028, bearing 6.0% interest. Funding may be in USD or digital assets. Notes rank pari passu with existing unsecured debt. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation—no change of control, acquisition, or strategic event. Watch for potential dilution or default triggers, but no risk-arb angle.
